pairs.evidence: src/components/layout-lab/steps/shared/CliProduce.tsx:33 The shared Produce primitive takes a pre-rendered prompt string from every call site instead of typed inputs. Bespoke steps such as ItemArt.tsx and ItemGate.tsx (outside this context) build their own `${entity.name} ... ${dir}` strings this way, so text the model reads bypasses the single assembler in src/lib/catalog/stepPrompt.ts: the many-doors sprawl the standard names.
